Dialogue.Speaker: Narrator
Lines: That night the hollow inside you fills - not with memory, but with a dream that is not yours.
A storm cliff. The world ending over a black sea.
Five weapons torn from the dark and driven into the stone: a meteoric hammer, a sword wreathed in flame, a moonlit spear, a great two-handed blade, a pair of bone daggers.
A seal carved in ruin. The castle woke - and the world knew something terrible had begun.

Dialogue.Speaker: Dariartimous
Lines: The seal is set, my lord. The five are given.

Dialogue.Speaker: Daverak
Lines: Thy loyalty draws nigh its proving, Seeker.
The prophecy is not silent. One is born who at his eighteenth year may sunder me. Atriartous. That is the name the stars have carved.
Only one can sunder me. See that he is undone - before he knows what he is.

Dialogue.Speaker: Dariartimous
Lines: It shall be done, my lord.
A ship crosses the northern water tonight. The boy is aboard it.
The sea will take him. And with him, every memory of the name you fear.

Dialogue.Speaker: Darius
Lines: You were talking in your sleep. A name.
You didn't recognise it. I could tell.
The sea didn't take everything. Remember the rest, and we'll know what we're walking toward.
